title: Example A/B protocol — synthetic fixture
instructions: This is a functional example for protocol authors. Both entries deliberately point to the same generated fixture; replace them with real candidate paths before collecting listening judgments.

questions.question: Does switching A/B preserve the exact playhead position?
questions.detail: Pause on a visible transient, switch tracks, and record the timestamp if the cursor moves.

questions.question: Record a precisely controlled playback time from this window.
questions.detail: Use the waveform, millisecond seek field, or ±10 ms controls, then include the time and what you targeted.
